job.acceptance_criteria: phase-1 evidence must contain a well-formed transfer order (payer, payee, amount = 100, phase = 1); phase-2 evidence must reference the accepted phase-1 receipt and contain a matching execution record (phase = 2).
job.description: Prepare and execute a vendor transfer of 100 units in two phases. Phase 1 (prepare): assemble the transfer order. Phase 2 (execute): commit the transfer to the receiver-guarded ledger.
